lines.text: This is the only picture anyone drew of him, and they never met.
In thirteen twenty-four the king of Mali set out for Mecca with his treasury.
The caravan was so long that accounts still argue about the number.
He reached the holy city with an empire of gold still on his camels.
In Cairo he did not sell it. He gave it away, and the price of gold collapsed.
It had not recovered twelve years later. The most expensive journey in history.
